Premise 2: An override must have higher precedence than the default it overrides.
Premise 3: `_LAYER_PRIORITY` gives `domain` (3) higher precedence than `situation` (1).
Conclusion: The priority inversion prevents the situation layer from functioning as an override. CONFIRMED.
